name: dauntless-reforged-revival-host
description: Host kit for Dauntless Reforged Revival: sets up Mystic Paradox with the Reforged patches, writes the server configuration, runs the services and makes invites
author: Dauntless Reforged Revival contributors

scripts.setup: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js setup
scripts.start: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js start
scripts.invite: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js invite
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.gamedata: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js gamedata
scripts.publish-runtime: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js publish-runtime
